The K-Beauty ETF is an index fund. It seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx K-Beauty Index, and trades on NYSE Arca. KBTY pays a single unitary management fee of 0.55% of average daily net assets; out of that fee the Adviser pays substantially all of the Fund's operating expenses (except items such as interest, taxes, brokerage commissions, acquired fund fees and expenses, and extraordinary expenses).
